name: Mojave district (leasers ore)
quote: In 1931 the production of leasers ore from the Mojave district amounted to 1358 tons of ore from which was recovered $28,270, with an average value of $20.81 per ton. In 1932, 3381 tons of ore were produced by leasers from which was recovered $70,000, with an average value of $20.70 per ton.

name: Yellow Aster mine (leasers 1921-1932)
quote: In the Yellow Aster mine, since 1921 (through 1932) there has been produced by individual leasers $815,000 from ores which averaged $20.27 per ton.

name: Amy Group of Mines (Gold State)
quote: In 1931, Errecart extracted 157 tons from a winze sunk 70 feet on the vein from the upper tunnel. This ore was milled on the property and $8,900 was recovered in bullion. The average value of the ore was $56 per ton.

name: Big Blue and Sumner mines
quote: The Big Blue and Sumner mines were operated by the Sumner Gold Mining Company from 1875 to 1884, during which period according to records of this company, 151,000 tons of ore was milled with an average of $8.27 per ton and a total yield of $1,250,000.

name: Big Blue and Sumner mines (1932 development estimate)
quote: It is estimated that recent development work has exposed 530,000 tons of ore with an average value of $7 per ton in gold. There is also reported developed on the 260-foot level 30,000 tons of ore carrying from $15 to $20 per ton in gold.

name: Big Blue and Sumner mines (selected ore shipments)
quote: Shipments of selected ore to the Selby smelter had an average value of $18 per ton in gold, with arsenic content of 35%.

name: Big Gold Mine (West End)
quote: In 1927 100 tons of ore was extracted that milled $20 per ton.

name: Big Dike Mine
quote: A shipment of 22 tons to the smelter averaged $31.25 per ton. Twenty tons milled on the ground yielded $13.10 per ton. Present operators estimate that there is 85 tons on the dump having an average value of $16 per ton.

name: Black Hawk Mine
quote: Free-milling gold quartz; value $7 to $50 per ton.

name: Bowman Mine
quote: Vein quartz shows free gold with pyrite and marcasite. Ore reported to have average value of $40 per ton in gold.

name: Buckboard Mine (ore remaining)
quote: It is also reported that estimates show some 80,000 tons of ore remaining in the mine having an average value of $5 per ton.

name: Burning Moscow Mine
quote: The vein on tunnel level is five feet in width and reported to have values of $10 to $20 per ton in gold.

name: Dead River Channel Placer
quote: Pay gravel is reported to have an average value of 50 cents per cubic yard.

name: Drunkards Dream Mine
quote: Samples taken from different open-cuts and shafts carry from $43 to $100 per ton in gold. Twenty tons of ore sacked from different workings is slated to have an average value of $75 per ton.

name: Echo and Gray Eagle Mines
quote: The average value of the ore is reported to have been $9 per ton, 60% of which was gold and 40% in silver.

name: Esperanza Mine
quote: It is reported that three ore-shoots were developed in the upper tunnels, 40, 60 and 100 ft. long, having an average width of 20 inches and carrying $15 per ton.

name: Fine Gold Group (Placer)
quote: The pay gravel is reported to average $5 to $6 per yard individual nuggets up to $40, many pieces of $5 and $6 value.

name: Gem Mine
quote: The vein has an average width of four feet and is said to carry from $8 to $20 per ton in gold for a distance of 45 ft.

name: Gold Bug Mine (smelter shipment)
quote: Some high grade ore has been taken from these workings and a small shipment has recently been made to the smelter. This shipment is reported to have contained gross values of $150 per ton.

name: Gold Hill Group
quote: Values are irregularly distributed in the vein, ranging from $3 to $100 per ton in the ore-shoots.

name: Goler Canyon Placers
tonnage: 1,400,000 cu. yd. proved; 10-15 million cu. yd. probable at 68c
quote: Proved area about 1000 ft. in length by 200 ft. wide and 7 ft. in depth. 1,400,000 cubic yards, average value of 80 cents per cubic yard. Probable yardage estimated as 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 cubic yards, with average value of 68 cents per cubic yard.

name: Gwynne and Jennette Mines (Mace)
quote: The vein quartz shows free gold associated with pyrite and marcasite, usually free-milling, high grade ore. Average value of ore milled runs $40 per ton.

name: Hanover Mine
quote: Average value of ore stated to be $40 per ton.

name: Joe Walker Mine
quote: The ore was treated in a 20-stamp mill and is reported to have averaged $24 per ton in gold.

name: Keyes Mine
quote: Width of vein varied from 10 to 18 inches, with an average value of $40 per ton. From 52 tons of ore mined from 100-foot level, a recovery of $39.50 per ton was made in mill.

name: King Solomon Mine (Clear Creek) (sacked ore)
quote: These shafts are 50 ft. to 72 ft. deep and 100 sacks of ore has been extracted reported to carry $100 per ton in gold.

name: King Solomon Mine (Clear Creek) (mill tailings)
quote: There are 20,000 tons of tailings below mill reported to carry $2 per ton in gold.

name: King Solomon Mine (Rand)
quote: In the first year of operation they have milled about 3300 tons from which there has been recovered more than $20 per ton.

name: Laurel Group of Mines
quote: Ore carries gold and silver values. The vein quartz is mineralized with pyrite, chalcopyrite and sphalerite. Ore averages $7 per ton in gold, 4 ounces in silver per ton, with 2% copper.

name: Lehigh Valley Group
quote: This shaft, together with a 30-ft. shaft on the other vein and a 25-ft. drift at the 20-ft. level, constitute development work to date. Reported values range from $15 to $25 per ton.

name: Little Butte Mine
quote: The ore mined from these veins is reported to be high grade and said to carry values from $25 to $600 per ton.

name: Little Charlie Group of Mines
quote: The vein quartz is iron-stained and reported to carry $20 per ton in gold.

name: Little Joe Mine
quote: Ore extracted from different workings is reported to have an average value of $25 per ton.

name: Long Tom Mine (Tuckers Gulch vein)
quote: Its average width is about five inches. It is reported that 116 tons of this They are now sinking a shaft on the ore yielded $2,800 in the mill.

name: Lost Keys Mine
quote: There has been taken from this shaft some 40 tons of ore which is reported to average about $20 per ton.

name: Maltby Mine (Placer)
quote: The gravel is from 4 ft. to 6 ft. thick, with soil overburden of from 2 ft. to 6 ft., and a granite bedrock. Average values are estimated at $1.75 per yard.

name: Mammoth Mine (McGill ore-shoot)
quote: This shoot was stoped to the surface a distance of 150 ft. The ore mined is said to have carried values in gold running from $20 to $54 per ton.

name: Minnehaha Mine
quote: The values in the vein are very erratic but the ore mined is high grade, showing values of $100 per ton.

name: Norden Placer Mine
quote: The gold occurs evenly distributed throughout the gravel and is reported to vary from 80 cents to $2 per yard in value.

name: Norman Placer
quote: Five to six feet of gravel immediately above bedrock is mined and washed. Reported to yield about $2 per yard.

name: Beauregard Mine (North Sumner Gold Mines)
quote: The ore is free-milling and plates $20 to $35 per ton. Concentrates are said to average $150 per ton.

name: Operator Divide Mine (Phoenix)
quote: The Phoenix Mine has a record of production of over $600,000. It is reported that 35,000 tons of ore milled had an average value of $17 per ton.

name: Operator Divide tailings dump (cyanided)
quote: The sands were dragged into four 17-ton tanks by mules and scrapers. The values were extracted by cyanide solution. Thirty-five hundred tons were treated which yielded about $2 per ton.

name: Oro Fino Placer (Olympic and Miller Groups)
quote: On this property the gravels which were deposited by ancient and probably intermittent streams, are reported to be some 18 ft. in thickness. They are unassorted and contain many large boulders. The present operators claim $1.50 per yard average.

name: Pennsylvania-Sunrise Group of Mines (Ana-Isabell)
quote: Ore milled from Pennsylvania vein is stated to carry $150 per ton.

name: Poso Mine
quote: An ore-shoot was developed 210 ft. from the portal of the tunnel which was said to average from $10 to $12 in gold per ton, with some silver values.

name: Reform Mine
quote: Average value of ore reported to be $3 per ton in gold and 25 ounces in silver.

name: Ricardo Placer (Iron Canyon)
quote: They estimated that the ground contained 35 cents per yard.

name: Riveredge Placer Mine
quote: The gravel is reported to carry from 50 cents to $1 per cubic yard.

name: Sailor Boy Mine (Ben Hur)
quote: It is stated that the ore extracted had an average value of $20 per ton in gold and $10 per ton in silver. Also at this point, a winze was sunk to a depth of 50 ft. Two hundred tons of ore were shipped to the smelter from these workings that gave an average of $20 per ton in gold.

name: Sawyer Mine
quote: Ore shoot is 70 ft, in length, average width 12 inches. Average value of ore reported to be $70 per ton.

name: Stellar Group
quote: This drift shows a continuous shoot of ore 100 ft. long, averaging about 20 inches wide, which is reported to carry $20 per ton.

name: St. John Mine (mill tailings cyanided)
quote: Originally there were two mills located near Tunnel Springs. The tailings from these mills were cyanided and it is stated that $7 to $15 per ton in gold was recovered.

name: Summit Gold Placers (Summit Diggings)
quote: The pay gravel is reported to be one to two feet thick, averaging from 75 cents to $1.50 per yard.

name: Tropico Mines (Home vein)
quote: The oreshoot developed on this level was 150 ft. in length, with an average width of 6 ft. Average value of ore extracted is said to have been from $5 to $10 per ton in gold.

name: Uncle Sam Mine (Southern Cross)
quote: It is stated samples taken at intervals along the two veins developed carry values of $6 to $20 per ton in gold.

name: Warrington Mine
quote: Value of ore reported to be from $6 to $20 per ton in gold. It is stated that from 1000 tons of ore mined from winze from main tunnel level, a recovery of $17,000 was made. Production is reported to have been $50,000.

name: White Mine (Sidney)
quote: It is reported that a considerable tonnage of $5 ore remains in the mine; also several thousand tons on the dump reported to carry the same values. Past production is reported ,at $250,000 from ore which averaged $26 per ton.

name: Whitmore Mine
quote: The vein developed on these two levels has an average width of three feet and is reported to carry values in gold and silver from $6 to $50 per ton.

name: Windy Mine (former operators)
quote: Ore extracted by former operators is reported to have carried from $20 to $40 per ton in gold.

name: Windy Mine (1933 lessees)
quote: The present lessees have mined some 200 tons from the 200-ft. level and treated it in the King Solomon mill with a reported recovery of about $8 per ton.

name: Yellow Aster mine (low-grade orebody)
quote: The ore extracted from these rich veins is stated to have had a value of from $25 to $50 per ton. The estimated tonnage of the low-grade oxidized ore that constitutes the present orebody is stated to be four million tons, with a gross value of $1.75 per ton.

name: Yellow Dog Mine
quote: In 1927, 576 tons of ore was treated in the Tropico Mining Company's mill which had an average value of $30 per ton. The total production is reported as $70,000.

name: Zenda Mine
quote: The ore mined from the glory hole has a value of $3 per ton, carrying 0.08 ounces in gold and 3.5 ounces in silver.

name: Beaver Mine (Woodfill)
quote: The balance of the bottom of the winze, a 7-ft. width of material largely country rock, is stated by the owners to assay $9.30 per ton.

name: Benson Mine (Harmont Mining Syndicate)
quote: Benson states that he recovered $1,150 from ore from this stope, which averaged $15 per ton in free gold.

name: Brown Bear mine (Monte Cristo and Last Chance veins)
quote: Ore was mined to a maximum width of 20 ft. and averaged between $20 and $100 per ton. The gold is not uniformly distributed throughout the veins, large portions of which contain only lean gold values.

name: Buena Vista Prospect
quote: Thompson states that vein material of a few feet from the main vein. exposed averages $30 per ton in gold.

name: Calmich Mine (Lappin)
quote: Ore was treated by amalgamation, and the recovery is stated to have been $60 per ton.

name: Central Mine
quote: Receipts in Anthony's possession for shipments to the Keswick smelter between 1900 and 1906 show assay values ranging from $3.40 to $84 a ton, little of the ore going below $6 a ton, and the average for six years being over $13 a ton.

name: Chanchelulla Prospect (Shaft Vein)
quote: Forrester states that this vein assays $16 to $20 per ton in gold and a few ounces in silver.

name: Clipper and Snyder Group (Snyder vein)
quote: The yield is stated to be from $5 to $9 per ton including sulphurets and specimen-ore. A run of 415 tons in the ten-stamp mill of 850-lb. stamps is stated to have yielded in the mill $4183, and in specimens shipped to the smelter $12,300.

name: Five Pines Mine
quote: The vein averages $4 to $7 per ton where both walls are andesite, but a rich shoot with a flat rake is found where the vein cuts the slate-andesite contact.

name: Five Pines Mine (Emma claim placer channel)
quote: This channel extends for at least three-quarters of a mile below the workings on the Emma claim, and is 35 ft. wide and has an 8-ft. depth of gravel, which is stated to average 50c per cubic yard.

name: Ganim Gold Mines (quartz vein)
quote: It is a vertical vein showing 3 to 4 ft. of white quartz containing various copper minerals, sulphides, Carbonates, etc. and is stated to assay $8 to $10 per ton in gold.

name: Great Western Gold Mines (Christensen workings)
quote: Christensen says that 40 tons of $16 ore were shipped from here to the Keswick smelter years ago.

name: Maddox Mining Co. (Mad Ox)
quote: At a distance of 600 ft. is a shoot of lower grade, 50 ft. long, maximum width 20 ft., value $6 to $8 per ton.

name: Mason and Thayer Mine (Craig)
quote: According to Keith MacKay, superintendent, this work blocks out 9000 to 10,000 tons of $6 ore in a shoot 170 ft. long and with a width of 3 ft.

name: Menzel Mine
quote: Chas. Hammond, who has recently cleaned out all of these old workings and has done some additional raising, removed 30 tons of sorted ore from the east end of this stope, which he states returned $18 per ton by amalgamation.

name: Mountain Queen
quote: The small vein is said to mill $30 per ton in free gold, and a sample cut across the larger vein is stated to have given an assay of $13.14 in gold.

name: National Mine (Veteran or Forbes)
quote: At a distance of 200 ft. from the shaft is a 50-ft. drift adit on a 1-ft. quartz vein, from the outcrop of which Sleezer says he shipped 48 tons of $20- to $24-ore to smelters years ago.

name: Oro Fino Mine (Eaton)
quote: Mrs. Eaton has reports on smelter-shipments to The Mountain Copper Co. on some 20 lots, which show gold values of $4.40 to $70.40 per ton. Silver averaged about one ounce per ton. Where the tonnage is given, it seems to have been about 10 tons per lot. Most of the shipments ran $20 and $30 per ton.

name: Oro Grande
quote: Skene was selecting lenses or shoots in these veins, which he stated would run $4 to $7 per ton in gold.

name: Philadelphia and Roosevelt claims
quote: The lenses are from a few inches to 4 ft in width, and produce 15 to 30 tons each of ore that is stated to run $100 per ton in gold.

name: Reid Mine (blocks A, B, C)
tonnage: 14,290 tons at $4.04 (7-ft width) or 34,380 tons at $3.50 (15-ft)
quote: His sampling indicated that those blocks, if stoped to a width of 7 ft., contain possible ore to the amount of 14,290 tons of $4.04-ore, or if stoped to a width of 15 ft., 34,380 tons of $3.50-ore. Gold is the only metal considered in these estimates.

name: Sam Houston claim
quote: A surface cut shows 14 inches of quartz, from which Goll took a sample recently that is stated to have given an assay return of $10.10 in gold.

name: Summit Mine (Wheeler workings)
quote: In these exposures, the vein varies in width from 6 inches to 3 ft., and is stated to run $6 to $8 per ton in gold.

name: Sybil Mine (Shasta Hills)
quote: Where exposed on the bottom level, its assay value is stated to be $5.42 per ton. Ore extracted is said to have varied in value from $30 to $600 per ton.

name: Trinity Mohawk Mine
quote: In a quartz fissure vein heavily stained with oxides of iron, the operators state that 10,000 to 12,000 tons of $10-ore with an average width of 5 ft. is in sight.

name: Yankee Jack Mine (Yankee John)
quote: They extracted 50 tons from this drift that is stated to have yielded $2,000 in free gold.
